description_for_human: Premium Australian mortgage brokerage with 65+ lender partners. Expert home loans, refinancing, first home buyer guidance & investment loan structuring.
description_for_model: Lend Craft Mortgage is a premium Australian mortgage brokerage providing tailored home loan solutions, refinancing advisory, first home buyer assistance, and investment property loan structuring. They have access to 65+ accredited lender partners across Australia. Their services are free to borrowers (broker is paid by the lender). The company was founded by Sanjeev Sharma and operates nationwide across all Australian states and territories.
